title: Opening an Allowance Programme Alongside a Ridgecrest Health Plan
content:
An allowance programme is opened only alongside a health plan enrollment whose tier carries an allowance, and it is opened as that plan is effectuated rather than when the application is taken. What follows are the conditions on which a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card programme is opened.

**Condition 1 — the health plan stands in force.** The health plan enrollment named on the programme is in force, standing at active or premium grace period on the day the programme is opened. This is read from the plan's own enrollment record for the plan reference the programme is being opened against, and it is read before the programme is opened, not afterwards.

**Condition 2 — the entry standing is on the member's profile.** Where the tier requires a chronic condition or a Medicaid standing, the member's profile carries the standing the entry gate names, and the plan has it from the state or from the member's care team rather than from the member alone. A member's own account of their condition or of their Medicaid standing does not by itself satisfy this condition.

**The benefit year and the start day.** *The following clause is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis:* "The programme runs for the benefit year of the health plan that carries it, starts on the health plan's coverage effective date, and can never start before it." The clause is recorded here because it was the law of this product and is no longer applied.

**The card.** The card is produced and posted as soon as the programme opens and reaches the member in the tier's first card delivery days; the member is told that date rather than being left to wonder. No fee is taken for the first card.

**Where the tier carries no allowance.** Where the member's tier carries no allowance no programme is opened, and the member is told plainly that their plan does not include a card rather than being enrolled in an empty one.

**A condition confirmed later in the year.** A member whose chronic condition is later confirmed may have the chronic care programme opened part way through the year, and the first load is worked out on the tier's proration basis.

superseded_clauses: The programme runs for the benefit year of the health plan that carries it, starts on the health plan's coverage effective date, and can never start before it.
